steps.content:
May 31, N.F. 116
9:45 PM

BR-003 Observation Hub

The final combat units complete their deployment half a day ahead of schedule. Every defensive Ring Weapon throughout the Hub is now on maximum alert. Entry is prohibited, and the barriers have been fully activated, operating at peak output.

The MBCC is not the only party handling security and defense. An elite unit under Paradeisos's direct command is also here. You've seen what they're capable of, and seeing them here again brings back memories... They appear just as inhuman as before.
Further out, supporting fighter aircraft from the FAC are also on standby.
This is the BR-003 Observation Hub at full combat readiness. If this level of security could become the norm, surely even the Underground wouldn't dare make a move. Of course, that would also mean...
This isn't just some "top security level experiment." The experiment itself doesn't even matter, but rather <color=#fb9259>the person</color> who will conduct it.

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: The data migration will be supervised by EDGE's representative. I'll coordinate all departments of the Observation Hub to support the operation.

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: Security and defense will be jointly handled by the Hush unit from Paradeisos and the MBCC. I'll leave that in your hands.
As she speaks, her aloof gaze sweeps past you. Your eyes meet briefly. You give a stiff nod in return. Both of you look away immediately.
Ever since that night, you've been avoiding each other like strangers. The reason is obvious: You both know exactly what the other person is planning.

21:55. An aircraft convoy of the highest security clearance arrives at the Observation Hub. You can't tell where it's coming from. One moment, it seems to suddenly appear in the air. The next, it descends and lands smoothly.

A white-haired woman, accompanied by Schorl and flanked by layers of guards, disembarks from the aircraft and walks through the long passage. Separated by her own security crew, she maintains a measured distance from you.
At one point, she seems to glance at you casually, then gives you a slight nod.

steps.speaker: Flawed Schorl
steps.content: Greetings from EDGE-02, Chief.

EDGE-02 enters the control room. The door closes behind her. Multiple anti-Mania barriers rise. It's now 22:00, supposedly the time window in which BR-003 is the most stable. How convenient that it falls exactly on the hour.
But you've always known that the real threat isn't out there in the distant Black Ring.

steps.speaker: Progress Report
steps.content: Data migration initiated. Current progress:
Fluctuations of the Black Ring are stabilizing. Field noise diminishes, and optical interference decreases slightly. In the distance, the Black Ring gradually comes into view.
Everyone remains on high alert as the experiment proceeds.
[Sound Effect] Crackle—
A faint, anomalous ripple sweeps through the field. The shackles detect it first.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Now.

steps.speaker: Flawed Schorl
steps.content: Copy. Relaying alert now. Initiating location scan. The exact location is...
[Red lights flash, alarms blare]

Multiple strikes hit simultaneously, scraping past the guards. Shrieking alarms tear at your eardrums as every alert goes off. The senior EDGE official has been inside the data center for only eight minutes when multiple impact points appear all at once across the monitoring zones.
You rush out first.

steps.speaker: Option
options:
All ambush teams, get in position! 
It's the Underground!!
